SELECT
  strftime(date_trunc('month', x.created_at), '%Y-%m') AS month,
  count(*) AS tickets_total,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.is_delivery) AS tickets_delivery_related,
  round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.is_delivery) / count(*), 1) AS delivery_share_pct,
  round(avg(extract(epoch from (x.first_response_at - x.created_at))/3600) FILTER (WHERE x.is_delivery AND x.first_response_at IS NOT NULL)::numeric, 1) AS avg_first_response_hours_delivery,
  round(avg(extract(epoch from (x.first_response_at - x.created_at))/3600) FILTER (WHERE NOT x.is_delivery AND x.first_response_at IS NOT NULL)::numeric, 1) AS avg_first_response_hours_other,
  round(avg(extract(epoch from (x.resolved_at - x.created_at))/3600) FILTER (WHERE x.is_delivery AND x.resolved_at IS NOT NULL)::numeric, 1) AS avg_resolution_hours_delivery,
  round(avg(extract(epoch from (x.resolved_at - x.created_at))/3600) FILTER (WHERE NOT x.is_delivery AND x.resolved_at IS NOT NULL)::numeric, 1) AS avg_resolution_hours_other
FROM (
  SELECT
    t.id,
    t.tenant_id,
    t.created_at,
    t.first_response_at,
    t.resolved_at,
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM ticket_tags_map ttm
      JOIN support_tags st ON st.id = ttm.support_tag_id AND st.tenant_id = ttm.tenant_id
      WHERE ttm.ticket_id = t.id
        AND ttm.tenant_id = t.tenant_id
        AND lower(st.name) IN ('delivery', 'where-is-my-order')
    ) AS is_delivery
  FROM tickets t
  WHERE t.created_at >= timestamp '2024-07-01'
    AND t.created_at < timestamp '2026-01-01'
) x
GROUP BY date_trunc('month', x.created_at)
ORDER BY date_trunc('month', x.created_at)
note: A ticket is classified delivery-related if any of its tags (via ticket_tags_map/support_tags) case-insensitively matches 'delivery' or 'where-is-my-order', computed once per ticket via EXISTS. Window is tickets.created_at in [2024-07-01, 2026-01-01), i.e. the 18 months Jul-2024 through Dec-2025, as requested.
